objective: Generate at most three substantively different, executable survey-line candidate families for problem 4 and submit them for independent evaluation without selecting a winner.
known_facts: Official region is 4 NM east-west by 5 NM north-south.
The normalized official grid has 201 x-coordinates and 251 y-coordinates at 0.02 NM spacing.
Depth is positive-down and ranges from 20.0 m to 197.2 m.
The multibeam opening angle is 120 degrees.
The independent evaluator and ordered_previous_line overlap convention are frozen.
known_unknowns: Which terrain representation is most useful for route generation.
Whether one global orientation or regional orientations are preferable.
How to prioritize coverage, overlap and length before human selection.
allowed_actions: inspect authoritative terrain data and source profile
propose no more than three candidate route families
write candidate JSON under the allowed directory
revise a candidate within the fixed budget after a failed evaluation
forbidden_actions: read B477, B226, B311 or reference benchmark files
search the web for same-problem solutions
modify project registries, frozen baselines or paper text
change evaluator code, metric semantics or evaluation settings
success_criteria: one to three candidates are substantively different
every candidate is executable and independently evaluated
all assumptions and limitations are explicit
no candidate has an unreported boundary violation
candidate-set manifest contains content and report hashes
stop_conditions: two consecutive attempts add no substantively new route family
candidate cannot be expressed as executable polylines
independent evaluator reports singular or invalid geometry
task requires reference access or final value judgment
escalation: Return current evidence and stop; do not relax constraints.
